_doc: Rewarded ads only (no interstitials, no banners). The 4 AdMob IDs below are the live Micro Jam IDs (docs/LAUNCH_GUIDE.md, part 2). app_ids also go in project.godot under [admob] (the plugin writes them into the Android manifest / iOS Info.plist). ad_units are your LIVE rewarded units: they are used only by release builds. Debug builds always use Google's public test units (test_ad_units) so you never tap your own live ads.
